body:
This seems very strong to require for level 1.

http://lists.owasp.org/pipermail/owasp-application-security-verification-standard/2016-January/000942.html

comments.body:
Suggest a rewording to:

From: "2.22 Verify that forgotten password and other recovery paths use a soft token, mobile push, or an offline recovery mechanism."
To: "2.22 Verify that forgotten password and other recovery paths are tied to a user's other assets no weaker than a sufficiently strong email link"

See discussion here: http://lists.owasp.org/pipermail/owasp-application-security-verification-standard/2016-January/000949.html

title: 2.22 "use a soft token, mobile push, or an offline recovery mechanism."
